risk_description: Fraud/identity model flags genuine rural and peri-urban customers at materially higher rates (synthetic evaluation: rural FPR 4.2% vs urban 0.7%).
cause: Measurement bias in ID-match and device/geolocation signals; under-representation in training data; biased historical labels.
existing_or_proposed_control: Pre-deployment fairness gate (FPR ratio <= 1.25 and disparate-impact 0.80-1.25 vs reference); label-bias audit; capture-quality-aware ID scoring; audit-calibrated thresholds; quarterly re-test.

risk_description: Unlawful or excessive processing of personal and biometric data (no valid lawful basis, over-collection, purpose creep).
cause: Broad data collection to improve model accuracy; unclear lawful-basis mapping; biometric data is sensitive.
existing_or_proposed_control: Documented lawful basis per processing purpose; data minimisation review; retention schedule; DPIA before go-live (NDPA s.28); privacy-by-design sign-off.

risk_description: Customers and reviewers cannot understand why they were flagged or declined, undermining contestability.
cause: Opaque scoring; no reason codes; no customer-facing notice of automated decision-making.
existing_or_proposed_control: Reason codes for every adverse decision; plain-language notice; decision-review technique (feature contributions) in analyst tooling; model cards.

risk_description: Fully automated account holds or declines with no meaningful human review (automation bias; rubber-stamping).
cause: Throughput pressure; reviewers lack authority or time; score displayed without evidence.
existing_or_proposed_control: No solely automated adverse decisions without human review (NDPA s.37); reviewer authority to override; reviewer training; override-rate and review-time monitoring.

risk_description: Training and monitoring data under-represent customers outside cities, thin-file customers and some device types.
cause: Data collected from existing (mostly urban) customer base; digital-footprint gaps.
existing_or_proposed_control: Data sheet documenting coverage; stratified sampling; minimum per-group sample size for evaluation; independent verified audit sample.

risk_description: Breach of identity documents, biometrics or transaction data held by the platform or vendors.
cause: Large concentration of sensitive data; third-party dependencies; model/API abuse.
existing_or_proposed_control: Encryption at rest/in transit; least-privilege access; vendor due diligence; breach runbook with 72-hour NDPC notification (NDPA s.40); red-team testing with written authorisation.

risk_description: Fraud patterns and customer behaviour change so accuracy and fairness decay after deployment.
cause: Adversarial adaptation; seasonal and macroeconomic shifts; product changes.
existing_or_proposed_control: Drift monitoring (PSI, score distribution, per-group FPR/TPR); retraining protocol with re-approval; rollback plan.

risk_description: Reliance on external ID-verification, biometric or data-enrichment vendors with weak governance or hidden bias.
cause: Limited contractual transparency; unvalidated vendor accuracy across demographics.
accountable_owner: Head of Procurement and Vendor Risk
existing_or_proposed_control: Vendor AI due diligence questionnaire; contractual audit and incident-notification rights; independent accuracy testing by group; data processing agreements.

risk_description: Failure to meet NDPA obligations, or future EU AI Act obligations if the EU nexus arises.
cause: New regime (NDPA 2023, GAID 2025); evolving EU timetable; expansion plans not mapped to law.
existing_or_proposed_control: Legal obligations register; jurisdiction trigger review before each market launch; DPIA filed where required; regulator engagement; EU AI Act applicability check.

risk_description: Wrongly declined or frozen customers lose access to essential financial services with limited recourse.
cause: False positives concentrated on vulnerable groups; slow appeals; no interim access.
existing_or_proposed_control: Fast-track appeal (target 2 business days); interim access for low-risk holds; harm-based KPIs (time-to-resolution, reversal rate by group).

risk_description: AI incidents (bias event, mass false positives, data leak) are not detected, escalated or reported in time.
cause: No AI-specific incident taxonomy; unclear escalation owner.
existing_or_proposed_control: AI incident taxonomy and severity matrix; 24x7 escalation path to AI Governance Committee; post-incident review and lessons-learned log.

risk_description: Unclear ownership across product, data science, compliance and operations leads to unmanaged risks.
cause: No AI governance charter; ethics review not embedded in release process.
existing_or_proposed_control: AI Governance Committee with charter; RACI; mandatory go/no-go review; board reporting; internal audit of AI controls.
